The '''Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser''', also referred to as the '''Sandonian 4XA Prensile cruiser''', was a type of [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Its design featured at least one [[Wing (technology)|wing]], and it was equipped with twin [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] interior featured seats for the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and the copilot, and it had a cargo hold.<ref name="Tethan" /> The ship shared its name with the [[Sandonia system/Legends|Sandonia system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

The [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pwi'lin]] owned a Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser named the ''[[Rindoon Dart]]'', which he had fitted with a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] in addition to supposedly changing the position of the craft's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], thereby enhancing its performance.<ref name="Tethan" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the ''Rindoon Dart'' was landed at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] near a [[Unidentified Raidos cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raidos]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]].<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser&mdash;the fastest ship in the Galaxy!|A Tethan youngling in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Dyd2_bg.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser was introduced in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''.]]
The Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser was introduced in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In an adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], meets the character Pwi'lin in the Raidos [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Pwi'lin&mdash;who, unbeknownst to the youngling, intends to capture and [[Slavery/Legends|sell]] them to a [[Unidentified mine owner|mine owner]] in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] settlement<ref name="Tethan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>&mdash;lets the Tethan know that he owns a Sandonian 4XA Prensile Cruiser, which excites the youngling and makes them proclaim it the fastest starship in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], at which point the enslaver displays surprise at the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the backwater planet Teth being familiar with the craft.<ref name="Tethan" />

Pwi'lin subsequently invites the Tethan to see the vessel at the spaceport, and while giving them a quick tour of the modifications made to the ship, he captures, brings aboard, and binds them for transportation to Cloud City, where the captive is transferred to the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] owner's transport.<ref name="Tethan" />
